wiki.title: Laura Richardson
wiki.extract: Laura Richardson (born April 14, 1962) is an American politician who has served as a member of the California State Senate from the 35th district since 2024. A member of the Democratic Party, she previously served as the U.S. representative for California's 37th congressional district from 2007 to 2013.
